details: Designed and delivered responsive web applications focused on usability, speed, and conversion-driven user journeys.
Collaborated closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable frontend and backend architecture.
Improved performance, accessibility, and maintainability across several client projects using modern React and Next.js patterns.
Built polished landing pages and dashboards for startups and small businesses, resulting in smoother customer experiences.
Developed reusable UI components and streamlined design-to-code workflows for faster delivery across multiple projects.
Integrated APIs, optimized experiences for mobile devices, and ensured consistent cross-browser functionality.
